# PayScale

> > PayScale provides enterprise compensation management software and salary data solutions, including MarketPay, Payfactors, and Data API platforms for HR professionals.

PayScale offers comprehensive tools for compensation planning, pay equity analysis, and market-based salary benchmarking. The platform serves HR teams and organizations seeking data-driven approaches to employee compensation strategy.

## Key Topics

- MarketPay
- Payfactors
- Data API
- Compensation Management
- Salary Data
- Pay Equity
- Market Analysis
- HR Software
- Enterprise Platform
- Salary Benchmarking
- Compensation Planning
- Total Rewards
- Wage Analytics
- Compensation Intelligence
